info.title: Yusr API
info.description: Donations, case pipeline and operations for the Yusr platform. Amounts are integers in minor units (piasters, halalas, cents). Text fields that face donors are `{ ar, en }`. Send `Accept-Language` for server-side messages and `X-Request-Id` to correlate support tickets.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

get.summary: Readiness probe: PostgreSQL and Redis reachable
get.description: Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

post.summary: Payment notifications (Paymob, Fawry, Stripe, Moyasar)
post.description:
The signature is checked on the exact bytes before anything is read. Replays are acknowledged without being applied again; an amount or currency that differs from the order parks the donation for review instead of crediting it.

Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Rate limit: 600 per 60s per IP.

schema.description: Provider payload, verified byte for byte

get.summary: This API as OpenAPI 3.1
get.description:
Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Cached for guests for 300s.

Cached for guests for 60s.

get.summary: Browse published cases
get.description:
Filter by category, governorate, completion range, urgency and zakat eligibility. Cursor-paginated.

Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Cached for guests for 15s.

post.summary: Submit a case for review
post.description:
Starts the pipeline under_review → field_verified → published. A repeat national ID is flagged for reviewers, never rejected.

Requires a signed-in session.

Rate limit: 10 per 86400s per user.

get.summary: A case page: story, verified documents (redacted), disbursement plan and recent donations
get.description:
Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Cached for guests for 15s.

get.summary: The latest donations for the live ticker (anonymous donors stay anonymous)
get.description:
Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Cached for guests for 5s.

post.summary: Price a donation: provider, fee, amount charged and what reaches the case
post.description:
Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Rate limit: 120 per 60s per IP.

post.summary: Start a donation (guest checkout allowed) and get the next checkout step
post.description:
Idempotent: repeating a request with the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the same donation and checkout step; the same key with a different body is refused. The receipt token in the response lets a guest open the receipt.

Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Rate limit: 30 per 600s per IP.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 16–128 URL-safe characters, one per donation attempt (a UUID works).

get.summary: A receipt, for its donor, finance staff, or anyone holding its receipt token
get.description: Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

parameters.name: X-Receipt-Token
parameters.description: From the create response or the receipt email; lets a guest open the receipt.

post.summary: A 10-minute upload link into private storage (step 1 of submitting a document)
post.description:
PUT the file to the returned URL with the returned headers, then reference its key when submitting the case.

Requires a signed-in session.

post.summary: Send a 6-digit sign-in code by SMS/WhatsApp
post.description:
Codes expire after 5 minutes and allow 5 attempts; a phone can ask again after 60 seconds (Retry-After on 429).

Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

post.summary: Exchange the code for a session (staff add their authenticator code)
post.description:
Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Rate limit: 30 per 900s per IP.

post.summary: Sign in with a Google or Apple ID token
post.description:
The token is verified against the provider keys (RS256, audience = our client IDs).

Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Rate limit: 30 per 900s per IP.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token
post.description:
Each refresh token works once. Presenting a used one revokes the whole login (SESSION_REVOKED).

Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

Rate limit: 60 per 900s per IP.

post.summary: End this login on every device that shares it
post.description: Open to guests; a Bearer token is read when sent.

post.summary: Start authenticator-app enrollment (returns the secret and an otpauth:// link for the QR code)
post.description: Requires a signed-in session.

post.summary: Confirm enrollment with a first code; staff permissions need it from then on
post.description:
Requires a signed-in session.

Rate limit: 10 per 900s per user.

Requires a staff session with two-factor authentication.
